1/I was raped. I never pressed charges  because I had drugs in my system and the detective said that I wasn't credible for that reason. 
I know what it is like to have people doubt your story. It's been 18 years and I still see his face all the time. 
#IBelieveTara
#MeToo
2/ I have been felt up on the train coming home from work. I got off at the next stop and walked through 3 towns to get to my car rather than risk him still being there. #ibelieveher #MeToo

3/I had fallen asleep at a friend's house (being 6 months pregnant wears you out) only to wake up by another guest grabbing my hand to put on his penis. I just left and never said anyhing because of the fear that people would say it was my fault. 
#Ibelieveher
#MeToo

@Jenny__Blue Ok, let's say they are false, Biden still doesn't understand personal space, and he has joked about it. In this era of #metoo we should not be making jokes about it. 
The only reason I am still voting for him, is because I have to hope his running mate would make it worth it.
